# CareSupport

> CareSupport is a family care agent that lives in iMessage. Families text it like a trusted helper; it turns those messages into a shared care system — medication tracking, schedules, caregiver handoffs, and status summaries — with no app to install.

CareSupport is built for the person who carries the coordination burden in a family care situation: adult children coordinating a parent's care, spouses managing caregivers and agencies, and the family members who share the load.

## How it works

- You text CareSupport like you'd text a person. There is no app, dashboard, or login.
- It remembers the people, medications, schedules, and preferences in your care situation.
- It can reach out to caregivers and care contacts on your behalf, with your permission, and report back.
